issue.title: Five ACE visual PNG tests fail deterministically on clean master in agent workspaces: external/linked repo panels and LLM Calls detail levels
issue.description: Five ACE visual PNG tests fail on a clean master tree in an agent workspace; three share the signature that a repo-role label is missing from the rendered agents panel. See the CI failure body for nodes, evidence, and effect on golden regeneration.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Observed 2026-09-20 on host apollo in agent workspace sase_16 at master d949f060e (== origin/master), with `just fix-tui-screenshots`. Not intermittent: each node below failed in 3 of 3 runs on the same tree -- a full visual run, a targeted 7-file run, and a check-mode run (`just test-visual`) on a pristine tree with every local change stashed.

Failing nodes:

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_external_repos.py::test_agents_external_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot` -- `assert_page_svg_contains(page, "external repo")` fails (tests/ace/tui/visual/_ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py:74) right after the same helper found `gh:pallets/click`, so the repo name renders but the "external repo" label does not.
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_linked_repos.py::test_agents_linked_repo_diff_file_panel_png_snapshot` -- same signature: `assert_page_svg_contains(page, "linked repo")` fails right after `sase-core` was found.
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_linked_repos.py::test_agents_commit_messages_panel_png_snapshot` -- also fails in the same run (assertion in the same helper; exact text not captured).
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_llm_calls.py::test_agents_llm_calls_panel_detail_level_png_snapshots` parametrizations `1-agents_llm_calls_panel_expanded_120x40` and `2-agents_llm_calls_panel_full_120x40` (the level-0 parametrization passes); failure signature not captured.

Root cause NOT established. The first three share one signature (a repo-role label absent from the rendered agent panel), which suggests one shared cause rather than three; a workspace-path-length truncation like sase-13u is one candidate, unverified.

Effect: `just fix-tui-screenshots` refuses to write ANY golden while a failing test is selected (`visual pytest failed; candidates were retained but goldens were not changed`), so anyone regenerating goldens on this host must deselect these nodes with `-k`, and their own goldens can then not be refreshed here.

Related, distinct: sase-13v (retry e2e nodes and two other agents-panel nodes), sase-x5 (agents-panel golden drift backlog), sase-13u (path truncation under the long agent basetemp).
